criteria.criterion: Provide all five listed vercel_dev_sandbox_* tools: preview-only owned create, bounded run, bounded write-files, safe read-file and stop with strict session identity and profile enforcement.
criteria.evidence: Five registered developer tools in src/tools/dev-sandbox.js use scoped V-1 ownerRun/guarded write, exact native session readback and visible profile registry; tests/unit/dev-sandbox.test.js, dev-v4-v5-doors.test.js and dev-v4-native-provider.test.js cover schemas, isolation and denial.

criteria.criterion: Reserve configured sandbox minutes atomically across two overlapping sessions/instances and enforce the 60-minute daily policy without treating minutes alone as paid-provider cost authorization.
criteria.evidence: 2026-10-17 OWNER SUPERSESSION: the pre-code daily 60-minute enforcement criterion was rejected by the owner after freeze. src/db.js now atomically records requested usage without consulting the legacy quota or denying sessions over 60/day; src/tools/dev-sandbox.js permits 1–1440 minutes per Pro provider session and invokes usage-only accounting. tests/db/dev-sandbox-budget.test.js exercises four concurrent 20-minute requests, total >60 and legacy configuration=1, foreign account isolation; tests/unit/dev-sandbox.test.js covers 24-hour session maximum. Historic frozen criterion remains verbatim, explicitly superseded in V-4.md and BATCH-V.

criteria.criterion: Record every sandbox ID on the initiating dev run, stop exact owned active sessions in cleanup, refuse foreign/production sessions and unverified provider outcomes.
criteria.evidence: Created Sandbox sessions are recorded as run-owned dev_run_objects with a durable pending create intent; src/tools/dev-runs.js uses exact provider session identity and deterministic run-scoped name before stop, with verified stop state and no foreign deletion; unit provider-shape readback test covers stop and persisted cleaned state.

criteria.criterion: Verify pinned Vercel provider methods, bounded command/file response and the complete direct/broker/HTTP write-contract and real disposable database concurrency checks; preserve provider-spend/owner approval boundaries.
criteria.evidence: src/vercel/operations.js pins official v4/v2 Sandbox methods and openapi-validation.js narrowly handles provider's erroneous required cmdId; bounded filesystem gzip-tar and NDJSON logs are in native client boundary; tests/unit/dev-sandbox.test.js, dev-v4-native-provider.test.js, dev-v4-v5-doors.test.js and the repository CI emulator cover method/shape/transport; genuine provider charged Sandbox acceptance remains queued separately.

criteria.criterion: Provide vercel_dev_send_test_webhook to send only clearly labeled synthetic Vercel event types to a validated explicitly chosen public HTTPS development receiver bound to the active owned run.
criteria.evidence: src/tools/dev-test-webhook.js provides vercel_dev_send_test_webhook with prepare/send actions, strict active V-1 run and READY owned preview deployment binding, synthetic flag and limited Vercel event types; registry and direct/broker tests prove access and connection behavior.

criteria.criterion: Sign the exact transmitted body using the documented x-vercel-signature HMAC algorithm and a per-run secret protected by authenticated one-time owner disclosure, with no secret, raw request body or unsafe receipt data in tool results or audit.
criteria.evidence: Per-run authenticated one-time owner vault plus AES-GCM with hashed run AAD encrypts the HMAC signing key; exact raw body HMAC-SHA1 x-vercel-signature is independently compared to node:crypto in tests/unit/dev-test-webhook.test.js; generic guarded result tests check secret only disclosed on authenticated owner setup, not send receipts/audit.

criteria.criterion: Reject private/loopback/mixed-DNS and redirected destinations, prohibit production targets, time out boundedly, refuse blind retries of uncertain delivery and preserve run-scoped secret cleanup.
criteria.evidence: checkedReceiver and signedPreviewPost allow only an exact verified *.vercel.app preview HTTPS origin, reject unsafe path, metadata/private/mixed DNS and redirect, pin resolved public IP in TLS connection, limit timeout/bytes and never auto-retry ambiguous POSTs; run-scoped ciphertext is wiped after exact cleanup using tests/db/dev-sandbox-budget.test.js.

criteria.criterion: Verify signature independently, refusal/replay/transport isolation, provider-shaped event fixtures and all applicable write-contract, direct/broker/HTTP, catalog and security checks.
criteria.evidence: tests/unit/dev-test-webhook.test.js captures native HTTPS request headers and exact transmitted bytes to verify signature, public DNS pin, one-shot non-2xx and redirect refusal; dev-v4-v5-receipts, dev-v4-v5-doors, registry and generic write-contract tests prove redaction, replay and scoped dispatch. A real independently authorized scratch receiver and deployed native MCP/RTC acceptance remain PENDING.
